title: Boette, Rossignoli: History states of systems and operators (discrete history states)
locator: Sec. II up to II.1; Eqs. (1)-(15)
relevance: Defines the step-invariance formulation implemented here: constraint U|Psi>=|Psi> with U = sum_t U_{t,t-1} (x) |t><t-1|, closure U_{0,N-1}...U_{1,0}=1, J=-ilog U as cyclic Wheeler-DeWitt equation, degeneracy d_S per eigenvalue, folding of t-independent steps.
assumptions: Finite-dimensional clock of N readings; system S; step unitaries on S with product = identity; U = exp[-iJ], spectrum of J in [0,2pi).
conclusion: Every eigenvalue of U has degeneracy exactly d_S = dim H_S; conditional states |S_t> = sqrt(N)<t|Psi>Psi have unit norm for normalized Psi; J contains S-T interaction terms exactly when the steps are t-dependent.
proof_status: Paper's Sec. II statements; the degeneracy and chain claims re-verified numerically in our B2 implementation (degeneracies [2,2,2], chain residual 3e-15, model_output.txt Sec. 2).
open_questions: BR do not connect their construction to eigenvalue-constraint models with a fixed H; the comparison of the two constraint types is not in the paper.
limits: Read scope is Sec. II only (same scope as the prior lane's read); sections II.1-III not read in this task.

title: Hausmann, Schmidhuber, Castro-Ruiz: Measurement events relative to temporal quantum reference frames
authors: L. Hausmann, J. R. Schmidhuber, E. Castro-Ruiz (published: Quantum 9, 1616 (2025))
locator: Sec. 5 (Eqs. 24-27, 116-122) and App. G; rest keyword-searched
relevance: Discrete-time analogue of the purified-measurement constraint: invariance under one clock step U = sum_k |t_{k+1}><t_k| (x) U^{(k)}, reading-controlled steps, no closure condition (clock is infinite, t_k = k pi/E). Solution structure |psi(t_{k+1})> = U^{(k)}|psi(t_k)> verified as our B3 variant's chain relation.
assumptions: Bandlimited clock with orthonormal sampling basis; steps act on system + ancilla; invariance under the single step unitary.
conclusion: Conditional evolution is exactly unitary for discrete steps; the model is explicitly NOT a discretisation of their continuous-time Sec. 4.2.
proof_status: App. G derivation read; consistent with BR Eq. (4) on the finite cyclic case where wraparound adds the closure condition.
dependencies: Their Secs. 2, 4.2 for context (not needed for Sec. 5's algebra).
open_questions: HSC cite Mondragon, Perez, Rovelli PRD 76, 064005 (2007) as 'a similar model'; unread here (also unread in the prior lane).
limits: Their clock is infinite and aperiodic; the finite Z_3 case is our extrapolation using BR's construction, not an HSC claim.

title: Ludescher, Mekonnen, Galley, Mueller: Quantum reference frames beyond subsystems (Example 32, finite Abelian non-local Page-Wootters clock)
authors: T. D. Ludescher, A. M. Mekonnen, T. D. Galley, M. Mueller
locator: Sec. IV.1 (definitions of Z_n positions, characters, |d;p>, seeds M_g) and App. B.2 Example 32 (Eqs. 58-60); rest keyword-searched
relevance: The Z_n group-action formulation: constraint H = P_1+P_2+K(X_1-X_2)^2 with [interaction, gauge] = 0 giving a valid Z_n action; H_phys = span{|d;Kd^2>}; seeds M_g = sqrt(n)|g><g| (x) 1; local seed gives g-dependent (non-Schroedinger) perspectival dynamics, center-of-mass seed gives fixed generator K(X_1-X_2)^2 (Eq. 60).
assumptions: All spectra Z_n-valued; interaction commutes with the gauge generator P_1+P_2; seeds as coherent-state projectors restricted to H_phys.
conclusion: Physical space keeps dimension n with an interaction; local seed does not decouple the clock, center-of-mass seed does.
proof_status: Construction re-implemented verbatim (C0 replica): all six structural checks pass to <= 3e-15 (model_output.txt Sec. 3), including the g-dependent local step map (maxabs difference 1.7321 between consecutive steps) and Eq. (60).
dependencies: [59, 58] of that paper (finite Abelian PN framework) not read.
open_questions: Whether the framework applied to a real-valued constraint spectrum (our model) was intended by the authors; our Fix(e^{-i(2pi/3)H}) reading is our extrapolation, labelled as such in SPEC.md.
limits: AUDIT NOTES (non-propagating, verified numerically): (i) Example 32's single-particle definition |p> = n^{-1/2} sum_g conj(chi_p(g))|g> is inconsistent with Eq. (60) is prefactor-independent and verifies exactly.
